correctness.rationale: The locality-one upper bounds are proved directly from coordinate-partition structure, the binary linear upper bound follows from the published three-block LP value, and all three attaining linear witnesses were exhaustively checked.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Prior construction ingredients are explicitly disclosed and not claimed as new; no inspected source states the combined exact closure of the three residual parameter rows.

value.rationale: The result removes all three exceptions in the recent exact linear-dimension table and strengthens two rows to exact maximum sizes for arbitrary codes.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
